text: Composting enriches soil by adding vital nutrients and organic matter, promoting healthy growth in plants and promoting soil structure. By reducing chemical use, composting supports sustainable gardening practices. Mulching with compost or twigs helps retain soil moisture, suppress weeds, and regulate soil temperature, contributing to a more efficient and environmentally friendly gardening approach. This practice enhances soil health and supports a balanced ecosystem, ultimately leading to more resilient and productive gardens.
summary: Composting enriches soil, promotes healthy growth, reduces chemical use, and supports sustainable gardening. Mulching with compost or twigs helps retain soil moisture, suppress weeds, and regulate soil temperature.
